title: Claude Agent SDK (Python)
summary: ClaudeSDKClient with in-process MCP tools, can_use_tool as the approval gate, no built-in tools, turn and budget limits.
verified: RUN: tests and gold set ran here against the offline stub with claude-agent-sdk 0.2.186 (same tools, same permission callback). The live path was started once with 0.2.180: the SDK accepted these options and launched its bundled runtime, which stopped at sign-in because this sandbox holds no model credentials. No live model call was made.
stack_line: A Claude Agent SDK agent in Python (claude-agent-sdk 0.2).
run_cmd: uv run -m agent.app "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
live: The SDK drives the Claude Code runtime bundled with the package. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or the Bedrock variables) and AGENT_MODE=live.
next: Replace the tool bodies in agent/tools.py with calls to your systems.
Route the approval in make_gate() to a real person (queue, chat, ticket) instead of the approve argument.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.

open_line: Anthropic is this stack's model by choice, recorded in `.qz/practices.json`; for an open-weight model, start from the LangGraph or OpenAI Agents SDK starter.

api.none: a command-line agent today; the 1.1 solution composer serves it over HTTP with approvals in the API

knowledge.none: answers from its tools (the order lookup), not from documents; a RAG kit joins as a tool when it needs them
